data.body: INVESTIGATION: Jira sync requires operational credentials in CI (JIRA_API_TOKEN, JIRA_BASE_URL) and a running outbound-bridge.yml cron. No code fix is possible without verifying credential setup and CI workflow execution. Investigation needed: check recent outbound-bridge workflow runs in GitHub Actions, verify acli-integration.py has valid Jira credentials, confirm inbound-bridge.yml exists. Bug remains open pending infrastructure investigation.
